name: Where the Mask Ends
overview: An ambitious street urchin seizes the chance to impersonate a noblewoman and becomes a warlord's bride, but when her comatose husband awakens, she must navigate deadly schemes, win his heart through cunning, and uncover her royal heritage to triumph over rivals and rise from gutter to glory.

results.overview: A story about love and its different manifestations, told through the little boy Marcelino in search of his biggest dream: to meet his mother. Inspired by a famous book, the plot takes place in the 1940s.
results.name: Perfect Love

results.overview: Designer An Duoduo discovers that her fiancé Qin Lang is cheating on her during their wedding preparations. She catches her fiancé with her lover in bed, but doesn't call off the wedding. On her wedding day, she hires a man to be her future husband and marries him. A new romance between dogs and cats is about to begin!‌‌
results.name: Don't Mess With EX-Girlfriend

results.overview: The rape and murder suspect dies in the interrogation room due to being beaten up by the crowd earlier. The three teams responsible for this case are also imprisoned together, while the other suspect is still at large. After being released from prison, the three teams, led by their captain Cheng, track down their whereabouts. They pursue the culprit for twelve years.
results.name: The Lonely Warrior

results.overview: There is a street piano placed in a music store on a shopping district. Sawamoto Ren is a young electrician who has stayed away from the piano for a long time, but decides to start to a new path as a street pianist after meeting Kajiwara Midori, the daughter of the music store owner. Soon later, people from various backgrounds stop by to play the street piano and have heart-to-heart interactions with Ren and Midori.
results.name: Pianist in the Shopping District

results.overview: The miniseries addresses the difficulties in romantic relationships through the story of five middle-class couples with different views on marriage, love and fidelity. The protagonists, housewife Alice (Marília Pêra) and dentist Jorge (Cláudio Marzo), married for eight years, seem like a perfect couple. However, the union is in crisis because they are unable to have a child. Jorge discovers that he is sterile and, disappointed, does not reveal the fact to Alice, who suffers from not being able to get pregnant. The relationship becomes increasingly difficult due to the lack of dialogue and they become violent towards each other. A murder connects the plots: in the first chapter, the viewer learns that there was a crime, but does not know who the victim is: Jorge or Alice. The mystery is only revealed in the last chapter, when it is discovered that Jorge is the murderer.
results.name: Quem Ama Não Mata

results.overview: Expelled from the mansion where he was raised, driver Mariel becomes wealthy as a religious leader, while the Tavares Branco family goes into financial ruin.
results.name: Decadence

results.overview: A woman's daring sexual past collides with her married-with-kids present when the bad-boy ex she can't stop fantasizing about crashes back into her life.
results.name: Sex/Life

results.overview: Kampanerang Kuba was a fantasy soap opera television series broadcast by ABS-CBN in the Philippines. It was inspired by 1973 film with same title, which was starred by Vilma Santos and Bobot Mortiz. It was tagged as Pinoy Disney. It was originally based from a comic book series written by Pablo Gomez.
results.name: Kapmanerang Kuba

results.overview:
"Partner" centers around two law firms as they struggle to defend the accused and those around them. Kang Eun-ho, a widowed single mother & attorney, tangles with the charismatic and ruthless attorney Lee Tae-jo.

In the first two episodes the attorneys work on cases involving a step-brother chraged with murdering of his step-sister and a lawsuit between a wealthy mother-in-law and her divorced daughter-in-law.

Each successive episode will cover provocative cases like these, while also bringing to light the charms of the attorneys and their daily lives.
results.name: Partner

results.overview: An engrossing tale of Rajat's (Shine Pandey) journey of self-discovery as he moves from a village to a big city to pursue his dream of clearing the UPSC exams. The story follows Rajat as he explores his new-found freedom, builds new friendships, and experiences first love-all while navigating family pressures and staying true to his goal.
results.name: Dehati Ladke

results.original_name: 我才不要和人类恋爱呢
results.overview: Gu Zeyi, the merman prince, was captured by the human woman Lu Miaomiao. Gu Zeyi started a long journey of "chasing the beads." His three brothers made jokes in order to help the eldest brother retrieve them.
results.name: I Don't Want to Fall in Love With Humans

results.overview: Alien explorer Tang Mengyan has spent a century studying Earth. Before leaving, she reunites with her past-life lover, Ye Chenfeng. Ten years later, she returns to Earth to build a peaceful life with him, exploring how far their love can reach across time and space.
results.name: Over 40 Billion Light Years to See You

results.overview: When a heartbroken New Yorker moves to London hoping for a love story, she falls for an indie musician who's anything but the typical romantic hero.
results.name: Too Much

results.overview: When her husband is killed in a land grabbing attempt, Aline takes charge of cultivating his land and protecting his family. Facing the powerful Antonio La Selva, responsible for the death of her husband and the largest landowner in the region, Aline is determined to keep possession of her land and invest in its production. However, she didn't expect that she would fall in love with Daniel, son of her rival, who is at odds with his rebellious half-brother, Caio, who, in turn, also falls in love with the girl. In the interior of Brazil, Aline will have to fight two battles: the dispute for her lands and for her heart.
results.name: Land of Desire

results.overview: Set during the turbulent time of the fall of Goryeo and the founding of Joseon, two former friends face-off against one another over a woman and the future shape of the nation.
results.name: My Country: The New Age

results.overview: A tragic story about young sisters who part ways after their parent's divorce but reunite once again as mother and daughter-in-law in the whirlwind of fate, ending up in catastrophe after desire and conflict.
results.name: The Two Sisters

results.overview: Vidhi Sharma, a young woman, falls in love with Devvrat Raichand, a middle-aged tycoon. Together they embark on a journey of love and acceptance beyond the barrier of age.
results.name: Na Umra Ki Seema Ho

results.overview: After her father's death, a young girl enters the entertainment industry to support her family, only to find herself sacrificing a normal childhood while navigating fame, family struggles, and personal loss.
results.name: Fallen Rainbow

results.original_name: รักฉุดใจนายฉุกเฉิน
results.overview: Peng, an emergency room resident and Tantawan have been in love for 15 years. Tantawan, who owns magical power, starts to doubt whether Peng still loves her. One day, they met a traffic accident and Tantawan is seriously injured. When she wakes up, she loses all her memories. Unbeknownst to her, the truth about the accident was hidden.
results.name: My Ambulance
